item.name: Pyrrhic Cloak

effects.title: Retribution
effects.text: For the next 6 seconds, 75% of damage taken by the caster is reflected to the target unit as physical damage if they are within 1200 units away.

notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
item.lore: There are generals that care far less about the survival of their troops than the destruction of their enemies.
